description: Land Acquisition - Gangalagamuwa, Kalawana D/S Division, Ratnapura District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically declares that a particular parcel of land is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired, providing detailed descriptions of the land's location, boundaries, and extent. This falls squarely under Type 4 (Land Gazettes) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals.
